SEARCH
Package Data

Class Reservation_Repository

java.lang.Object
Data.Reservation_Repository
public class Reservation_Repository extends Object
Repository class for managing Reservation entities in the database. Supports "Logical Seating" simulation where TableID remains NULL until check-in. Handles confirmation code generation, lifecycle status updates, and reminder tracking.

      public Reservation getClosestReservationByContact(String phone, String email)

      public List<Reservation> getCompletedVisitsByUserId(int userId)
      Retrieves the history of completed dining visits for a specific user.

      A List of Reservation objects populated with their associated Bill details.

    • findConflictForRegularUpdate

      public LocalDate findConflictForRegularUpdate(DayOfWeek targetDay, LocalTime newOpen, LocalTime newClose, boolean isActive)
      Checks for scheduling conflicts between proposed operating hours and existing reservations. This method handles both standard shifts and overnight shifts (crossing midnight). * @param targetDay The day of the week to check (e.g., WEDNESDAY).
      Parameters:
      newOpen - The new opening time.
      newClose - The new closing time.
      isActive - True if the day is set to be open, False if the day is being closed.
      Returns:
      The LocalDate of the furthest future reservation that conflicts with the new hours, or null if no conflicts are found.

    • hasConflictForSpecialDate

      public boolean hasConflictForSpecialDate(LocalDate date, LocalTime newOpen, LocalTime newClose)
      Checks if a new special schedule (exception date) conflicts with reservations on that date.
      Parameters:
      date - The specific date to check.
      newOpen - The new opening time for that date (null if the restaurant is to be closed).
      newClose - The new closing time for that date.
      Returns:
      true if at least one reservation conflicts with the new hours, false otherwise.
